name: 32222 · Jacksonville, FL
findings: ZIP 32222 (Jacksonville) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32222 (Jacksonville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
